name: sticky-stack
title: Sticky stack
description: Panels that pile up under one another as the page scrolls.
use: A short sequence read one panel at a time as the page scrolls, where the ones read stay in view as edges: the steps of a process, the chapters of a story, a few plans. Every panel is a sticky-stack-item with a face of its own, such as a card or a sheet. When the panels should be seen side by side, or skipped through, use a carousel.

instead.when: The panels are seen side by side and scrolled across
The panels are reference a reader opens one at a time

platform.fallback: Every panel sticks on the same line, so each covers the one before it whole and no edges show

classes.name: sticky-stack
classes.description: The stack: its panels in a column, 1.5rem apart. It draws nothing and must not clip them

classes.name: sticky-stack-item
classes.description: A panel. It sticks --sticky-stack-top from the top of the scroller, one --sticky-stack-peek lower for each panel before it, until the stack ends

properties.name: --sticky-stack-top
properties.description: Where the first panel stops, from the top of the scroller; the height of a sticky header above it, and some room

properties.name: --sticky-stack-peek
properties.description: How much lower each panel stops than the one before it: the edge of a covered panel that stays in view
